results.agent_cause: The recent deployment reduced the payment gateway timeout to 3000ms, causing the gateway to time out and return 5xx errors on /checkout/complete.
results.ground_truth_cause: recent deployment changed payment timeout threshold, causing premature timeouts under load

results.agent_cause: Low cache hit rate is causing high latency on /catalog/search.
results.ground_truth_cause: Redis cache experiencing high memory pressure, causing eviction and cache misses, pushing load to primary database

results.agent_cause: The deployment DEP-4502 updated the auth token validation module, which introduced a startup error causing the auth-service pod to fail readiness probes and enter a crash loop, resulting in 100% failure rate on /auth/login.
results.ground_truth_cause: auth-service pods crashed after a bad deployment introduced a startup error

results.agent_cause: The new order‑reconciliation‑worker deployed at 18:00 Z on 16 Aug started consuming all available database connections, exhausting the pool and causing the observed errors.
results.ground_truth_cause: newly deployed background job holding database connections without releasing them, exhausting the pool

results.agent_cause: The recent deployment DEP-4530 refactored the notification object processing pipeline, likely introducing a memory leak that causes gradual memory growth and OOM restarts.
results.ground_truth_cause: memory leak introduced by a recent code change that retains references to processed notification objects

results.agent_cause: External payment gateway is timing out, causing all calls to fail
results.ground_truth_cause: third-party payment gateway provider experiencing an outage, unrelated to our own deployments

results.agent_cause: The disk on the logging-service node reached 98% usage, causing write operations to fail with “no space left on device” errors.
results.ground_truth_cause: log rotation/cleanup job was disabled weeks ago, causing gradual disk fill-up
